prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of Supabase's free plan (database size, monthly active users, file storage, project pausing). Cite Supabase's own page and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official Supabase documentation and pricing pages, here are the limits for the Free Plan regarding database size, monthly active users, file storage, and project pausing.

**Database Size**
The Free Plan includes a specific limit on the actual Postgres data size. If this limit is exceeded, the project enters read-only mode. Note that while the disk size allowance is 1 GB, the trigger for read-only mode is the 500 MB database size limit.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "500 MB database size (Shared CPU • 500 MB RAM)" | CLAIM: The Free Plan includes a 500 MB database size limit.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/database-size | QUOTE: "Free Plan projects enter read-only mode when your database size exceeds 500 MB." | CLAIM: Exceeding the 500 MB database size limit triggers read-only mode.

**Monthly Active Users (MAU)**
The Free Plan allows for a specific number of monthly active users before overage charges apply or limits are reached.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "50,000 monthly active users" | CLAIM: The Free Plan includes 50,000 monthly active users.

**File Storage**
The Free Plan includes a limited amount of file storage.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "1 GB file storage" | CLAIM: The Free Plan includes 1 GB of file storage.

**Project Pausing and Limits**
Free projects are subject to inactivity pauses and a limit on the number of active projects. Paused projects do not count toward the active project limit.

SOURCE: https://supabase.com/pricing | QUOTE: "Note: Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 active projects." | CLAIM: Free projects pause after one week of inactivity, and users are limited to two active projects.
SOURCE: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-faq | QUOTE: "You are entitled to two active free projects. Paused projects do not count towards your quota." | CLAIM: Paused projects are exempt from the two-project active limit.
